title: Scaling Autoregressive Models for Content-Rich Text-to-Image Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Informal testing and qualitative observation of generated images for specific prompts (e.g., 'wedding clothes') to identify stereotypically female representations.

Informal testing and qualitative observation of generated images for specific prompts (e.g., 'wedding clothes') to identify biases toward Western attire and norms, likely stemming from English-centric training data.
